## VantaVault v0.5.33

Watch full VALORANT rounds, review abilities on the map, and turn a replay moment into a play.

### Highlights

- **Full-round replays** (recordedreplay) — Download a replay in VALORANT and open Round Review. Follow player movement and jump to kills, plants, or defuses.
- **Tactics Board** (recordedtactics) — Select **Plan from here** to open a replay moment as a play. Move agents, draw routes, and save it to your playbook.
- **Utility on the map** (recordedutility) — Jump to recorded abilities. See Cloudburst and Ruse coverage, or where Chamber landed after Rendezvous.

### Improved

- Replay Theater shows what each player is holding and lets you toggle vision cones, names, and map callouts.
- Local Client mode follows the Riot account signed in on your PC and reconnects when Riot refreshes the session.

### Fixed

- Round Review keeps the map in place while loading. Playback controls and player positions appear when the selected round is ready.
- Connection settings show **Connected** once the selected account matches the live Riot Client session.

### Download

- **Windows Portable** — `VantaVault-portable.exe`
- **Windows Installer** — `VantaVault_0.5.33_x64-setup.exe`

### Auto-update

Both Windows versions update from inside VantaVault.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.32...v0.5.33)
